title: Either comammox Nitrospira or archaea dominate as ammonia oxidizers in freshwater aquarium biofilters
description: This study characterized the composition of aquarium filter microbial communities using 16S rRNA gene sequencing and quantified the abundance of all three known groups of ammonia oxidizers using qPCR.
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from wastewater metagenome
wastewater enrichment sample containing two comammox Nitrospira strains
